name: AI Image Alt Text Generator
author: Amit Chowdhury

sections.description:
AI Image Alt Text Generator is a powerful WordPress plugin that enhances image accessibility and SEO by generating SEO-optimized alternative text for your images using artificial intelligence.

Whether you’re managing a blog, business site, or online store, this plugin saves time and boosts discoverability with meaningful, keyword-rich alt text.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Alt Text Generation
    Generate SEO-optimized alt text using artificial intelligence for your WordPress images.

  • Multilingual Support
    The plugin supports multilingual setups, generating alt text in the language of the site.

  • WooCommerce Integration
    Automatically generate alt text for product images in WooCommerce.

  • Image Analytics
    Track images without alt text and get insights into how many images need attention.

  • Bulk Alt Text Generation
    Generate alt text for multiple images at once, saving time and effort.

Privacy Notice

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from users or site visitors.

If you enable the AI-based alt text generation feature, image URLs are sent to an external service (https://alttext.axilweb.com) for processing. No personally identifiable information (PII) is shared.

This plugin complies with GDPR guidelines by requiring user consent via manual API key entry in the settings panel.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • WooCommerce 4.0+ (if using for product images)

External Services

  • This plugin makes API calls to the following external service:

    • Service: [AxilWeb AI Image Alt Text Generator API] (https://alttext.axilweb.com/backendapp/api/api-key/generate-alt-text)

    • What data is sent: The plugin sends image data (or image IDs) to generate AI-based alt text for your images.

    • Why the data is sent: The data is sent to the API to process and generate descriptive, SEO-optimized alt text for images in your WordPress site.

    • When the data is sent: Data is sent when you manually or automatically trigger the alt text generation process (individually or in bulk).

    • Consent: API usage is optional. It is only activated when users explicitly enter their API key in the settings page.

    • Privacy and Terms of Service: By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of service and privacy policy of the external API.

      • Privacy Policy: https://www.axilweb.com/privacy-policy

      • Terms of Service: https://www.axilweb.com/privacy-policy

Security & Performance

  • Secure input validation and sanitization
  • Capability checks for admin features
  • Error logs and request history
  • Smart caching to reduce duplicate API requests

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip file via the WordPress admin panel (Plugins > Add New > Upload).
    1. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
    1. Go to Settings > AI Alt Text Generator to configure the plugin.
    1. Enter your API key to enable AI-powered alt text generation.
    1. You’re ready to start generating alt text!
sections.faq:
• Does this plugin send data to a third-party service?
    Yes. Only image URLs are sent to https://alttext.axilweb.com to generate alt text. No personal or sensitive data is sent.

  • Can I use this without WooCommerce?
    Absolutely. WooCommerce integration is optional. The plugin works with all WordPress images.

  • Will this overwrite existing alt text?
    No. Existing alt text will only be replaced if you choose to regenerate it manually or via bulk options.

  • Do I need an API key?
    Yes. The plugin requires an API key to connect to the external AI service.

  • Can I edit the generated alt text?
    Yes, all generated alt text can be reviewed and manually updated.

  • Will it work for existing images?
    Absolutely. You can bulk-generate alt text for previously uploaded media and product images.
